description: This file defines a Drupal form class 'TranslateEditForm' used for editing translation strings within the Drupal locale module. It includes methods for building, validating, and submitting a translation editing form, handling plural forms, and managing translation data.

classes.name: TranslateEditForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for editing translation strings, supporting plural forms and validation.

methods.name: getFormId
methods.description: Returns the unique ID of the form.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the translation editing form, including source strings, translation fields, and pagination.

methods.name: validateForm
methods.description: Validates submitted translation strings for disallowed HTML.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Processes form submission, saves translations, and manages cache refresh.
